title: On strong $R$-spaces
summary: In this paper, we mainly investigate some basic properties of strong $R$-spaces. It is shown that the property of being a strong $R$-space is closed-hereditary, saturated-hereditary and retractive, but not finite productive. Hence the category $\mathbf{S}$-$\mathbf{Top}_r$ of strong $R$-spaces and continuous mappings is not reflective in the category $\mathbf{Top}_0$ of $T_0$-spaces and continuous mappings. It is proved that a $T_0$-space $(X, τ)$ is a strong $R$-space iff every nonempty $τ$-closed subset of $X$ is compact in $(X, τ^{d})$, where $τ^d$ is the de Groot dual of $τ$;…
